title: Domain Registrations: Auto-Renew Attempt and Reminder Calendar
content:
# Domain Registrations — Auto-Renew Attempt and Reminder Calendar

Billing operations calendar for Domain Registrations. All days are calendar days counted back from, or on from, the domain's expiry date.

## Auto-renew attempts

| TLD product | Auto-renew on by default | First attempt (days before expiry) | Retry days after a declined first attempt (days before expiry) | Years renewed per auto-renew charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | Yes | 30 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .ca Domain Registration | Yes | 35 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .com Domain Registration | Yes | 30 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .org Domain Registration | Yes | 30 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .net Domain Registration | Yes | 30 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .co Domain Registration | Yes | 35 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |
| .io Domain Registration | Yes | 35 | 14, 7 and 1 | 1 |

**Funding order (every TLD product):** account credit first, then the default card.

## Reminder emails

| TLD product | Renewal reminders (days before expiry) | Post-expiry notice sent within (days after expiry) |
|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .ca Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .com Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .org Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .net Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .co Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |
| .io Domain Registration | 30 and 7 | 5 |

## Hypothetical calendar

For a hypothetical .ca Domain Registration expiring on 20 October 2029 with auto-renew on, the first auto-renew attempt falls 35 days earlier, on 15 September 2029; after a declined first attempt the retries fall on 6 October, 13 October and 19 October 2029 (14, 7 and 1 days before expiry). Renewal reminders fall on 20 September and 13 October 2029 (30 and 7 days before expiry), and the post-expiry notice is due within 5 days after 20 October 2029. For a .com Domain Registration with the same expiry date the first attempt would instead fall 30 days earlier, on 20 September 2029.
